caption: The drawing depicts a single, closed treasure chest placed at an angle on a plain, light-colored background. The chest has a curved, domed lid and is rendered in shades of brown with lighter and darker patches, suggesting worn or aged wood. The edges and seams of the chest are reinforced with metallic bands, colored in silver or gray, and are accented with evenly spaced, round metal rivets. The front panel has a visible clasp for securing the lid. On the top of the chest, there is a circular metal pattern with small studs, enclosing the engraved letters “CP” or a similar combination. The left end of the chest shows a round metal fitting. The lines and coloring are soft, contributing to a realistic yet stylized appearance. Below the chest, the name "Harry Mann Waddell" appears in plain capital letters, indicating the artist or creator of the drawing.
title: Cowhide Trunk
